Hangzhou杭州

E-commerce, live streaming and a government that courts founders.

Registered address
¥5k–16k / year
Typical setup
3–6 weeks
Region
Yangtze River Delta
Best suited to
E-commerce, consumer brands, SaaS, live commerce and supply-chain software; anything that sells through Alibaba's ecosystem.

Hangzhou built its reputation on Alibaba and never stopped. The city has the densest cluster of e-commerce operators, live-streaming agencies, consumer brands and the software vendors that serve them, and local government has been unusually willing to subsidise offices, hiring and intellectual property for companies it wants.

It is also a more livable city than Shanghai or Shenzhen, which matters when a founder is deciding where to spend three years. The foreign community is smaller, and English-language professional services are thinner outside the largest firms.

What actually differs here?

Hangzhou is generous to companies that commit and impatient with tests. If you are still deciding, visit for a month before you register.

Yuhang and Binjiang have the strongest startup supply; Xihu is scenic and expensive; the cost base is roughly 70% of Shanghai's.

Before you commit to an address here

The figures on this page are ranges. District practice decides whether a specific address will register, bank and pass inspection — and it changes without much notice.

Take it to the counter: ask the district market regulator and the bank to confirm the address before you sign the lease, using the script in how to verify.

How to check it

Registration practice

How the paperwork actually goes in Hangzhou

Registry speed, address rules and the district-level differences that decide whether a plan is realistic.

Registering

Registration is through the Zhejiang provincial portal, with district review. Yuhang (未来科技城) and Binjiang are the startup districts; Xihu is the old tech cluster around the universities. Subsidy programmes are real but usually require local tax registration, local hiring and a multi-year commitment.

Banking

Hangzhou banks are comfortable with e-commerce and platform settlements, including Alipay flows. Opening an account is still a face-to-face process, and a company whose revenue arrives through a marketplace may be asked for platform statements and contracts.

Work permits

Work permits are processed by the municipal science and technology bureau. Hangzhou is generally welcoming to foreign founders, but the company needs a genuine office and a tax record, and the permit is tied to the employer.

Address supply

¥5k–16k / year. Expect a lease, a property certificate and a utility bill in the company's name before a bank will look at the file.

Know before you commit

Three risks in this city

  • Building on a platform's API without a written data-processing agreement.
  • Taking a subsidy that requires local headcount and then hiring remotely.
  • Assuming a live-commerce licence covers ordinary e-commerce, or the reverse.

Best suited to

E-commerce, consumer brands, SaaS, live commerce and supply-chain software; anything that sells through Alibaba's ecosystem.
